plateau.reference: Maintain last significant-improvement reference separately for each of15metrics; subthreshold cumulative gain can count. Any metric meeting its own delta resets one shared patience counter. Keep raw maxima separately. Reset patience at each LR reduction, retain references.
plateau.initialization: Initialize all15 references from complete epoch0 native144-scene VALIDATION, never128-only or a partial evaluation.

recovery_trend_guard.delta: Use the existing per-metric significant delta, no new threshold
recovery_trend_guard.rule: Within the current LR phase including its entry baseline, any metric whose current value exceeds any available trailing1/2/3 complete evaluated epoch value by its registered delta resets patience and blocks LR reduction/stop, even below historical best. Record metric/lookback/gain; never change best references, selection or promotion merely for recovery.

plateau.stop: After two preregistered LR reductions, require three further complete evaluated epochs with no significant improvement in any of15metrics. Missing/nonfinite/incomplete/changed-scope metrics never count as plateau.
plateau.qualification: Operational plateau on this finite TRAIN/development VALIDATION distribution and optimizer schedule only; not global optimum, mathematical capacity limit or TEST generalization. A quality-failing plateau is still plateau, not permission to train indefinitely.

validation.macro: Within each H, equalweight rooms x agentcounts, with perworld/perrecipient metrics and eligible denominators retained; no treating aliases as independent worlds.
validation.initial_128_comparison: Original v299 checkpoint on same48 frozen128VALIDATION scenes, all raw inputs/sourcefactors/receivedbeliefs/predictions unchanged before anyupdate.
validation.selection: Retain all epoch checkpoints and metricwise best/Pareto index. Label a reporting pick only: among128-protected checkpoints, maximize equal-size mean R8 peerwallF1, ties by unionaccuracy then earlierstep. If noneprotected, no promotedcheckpoint; retain originalv299. Do not mistake scalar selection for dominance.
validation.quality_not_stopping: 128protection/FPR/doors/topology determine promotion and quality verdict, not whether loss plateau was observed. Preserve failures.

execution.cap_verdict: budget_limited_not_plateau; save resumable actual progress, never mark converged. User authorizes continuing registered schedule while validation still improves, subject to occupancy/credits/disk safety; no fixed-update completion.
execution.preflight_witness_selection: Minimum common cached TRAIN index for rooms20 N16 across all three H, chosen solely from immutable manifest, before model output inspection. Index0 is absent and must not trigger implicit new data generation.
